# blanks-around-tables

- ID: `MD058`
- Category: Tables
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: yes
- Tags: `table`

Tables have a blank or comment line above and below.

## Why

Some parsers misread a table that has no blank lines around it.

## Options

This rule has no options.

## Fix

The fix inserts the missing blank line, keeping any blockquote markers. gomdlint
reports some tables without a fix, such as a table in a tight list when the
blank line would make the list loose. gomdlint may report a finding without a
fix when the fix would change a line with one character in brackets, such as
\[x\] or \[1\], or the lines around it up to a blank line, because it could add
or remove a task list checkbox.

## Example

This document breaks the rule:

```markdown
# Rules

The rules that fix what they find:
| Name | ID |
| --- | --- |
| no-hard-tabs | MD010 |
```

gomdlint reports:

```text
4:1 Missing blank line before table
```

The fix changes it to:

```markdown
# Rules

The rules that fix what they find:

| Name | ID |
| --- | --- |
| no-hard-tabs | MD010 |
```

## Configure

Under `rules`, `blanks-around-tables: false` turns the rule off and
`blanks-around-tables: error` reports its findings as errors. The flag
`--disable blanks-around-tables` turns it off for one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line blanks-around-tables -->
```
